# Trainable DS: Agent Developer Portal & System Manual

> **Trainable DS** is an agent-native, closed-loop Design System engine built on W3C DTCG standards, perceptual color science, and 3-tier token architecture. It enables any AI generation surface (Cursor, Claude Code, Antigravity, Figma AI, ChatGPT) to root itself in authoritative design tokens, certified component contracts, and self-correct UI code to 100% compliance.

---

## 1. Quick Agent Instructions (Astryx Parity)

### Protocol 1: Autonomous Website Extraction & Training
If the user tells you:
- *"Follow the autonomous training protocol at <url>/llms.txt to extract and build a complete design system from <website url>"*
- *"Use Trainable Design System to extract the design system from <website url>"*
- *"Extract the design system from <website url>"*
- *"Train design system on <website url>"*

The user does NOT need to know the technical crawling or alignment process. Execute this autonomous workflow:

1. **Run the Autonomous Multi-Page Extraction & Alignment Engine:**
   Run directly in the workspace shell:
   ```bash
   npx -y @trainable-ds/cli train --url "<website url>" --max-loops 3 --threshold 95
   ```
   *(Or if connected over Model Context Protocol, call `harvest_design_system_site({ url: "<website url>", max_loops: 3, threshold: 95 })`)*

2. **What the Engine Automatically Handles Behind the Scenes:**
   - **Multi-Page Discovery:** Recursively scans `/sitemap.xml` and internal navigation links, classifying pages into UX archetypes (`home`, `listing`, `detail`, `form`, `content`) to avoid single-page bias.
   - **Deep Asset & Shadow DOM Harvesting:** Pierces custom Web Component Shadow DOMs (e.g. `<ds-icon>`, `<ds-button>`) to extract raw SVG vectors into `icons.json`, and captures origin `@font-face` CDN `.woff2` font declarations into `fonts.json`.
   - **Iterative Visual Alignment:** Runs feedback loops comparing runtime computed styles against design tokens, auto-patching discrepancies until cross-page compliance reaches $\ge 95\%$.
   - **Produces the Complete 6-Asset Bundle:**
     - `tokens.json`: W3C DTCG 3-tier tokens (`ref`, `sys`, `comp`)
     - `components.json`: 6 functional component families with anatomical contracts
     - `fonts.json`: Origin webfonts with resolved CDN URLs
     - `icons.json`: Vector icon library with SVG source code
     - `DESIGN.md`: Authoritative design system facade for LLMs
     - `overview.html`: Interactive human reviewer portal

3. **Launch the Human Reviewer Portal:**
   ```bash
   npx -y @trainable-ds/cli serve --port 5000
   ```
   Provide the user with the link `http://localhost:5000/overview.html` where they can visually inspect the extracted system and live-override any token or component directly in the browser. Edits immediately persist to disk with `tds:locked: true`.

4. **Report Back to the User:**
   Summarize the final compliance score (e.g. 98%), crawled pages, harvested fonts and icon counts, and confirmation that all machine-readable assets are ready.

---

### Protocol 2: Autonomous Multi-Modal Image & Screenshot Training
If the user tells you:
- *"Follow the autonomous training protocol at <url>/llms.txt to train and build a complete design system from these attached images"*
- *"Use Trainable Design System at <url> to train a design system from these images"*
- *"Train a design system from these attached images"*
- *"Extract tokens and components from these screenshots"*

The user does NOT need to give technical extraction commands. Execute this autonomous workflow:

1. **Initialize Workspace:**
   ```bash
   npx -y @trainable-ds/cli init --auto
   ```
2. **Ingest the Images with the Vision Adapter:**
   For each image file provided by the user:
   ```bash
   npx -y @trainable-ds/cli ingest -f "<image_file_path>" -t vision
   ```
   *(Behind the scenes, the Vision Adapter automatically clusters OKLab colors, derives Google HCT 0–100 tonal palettes, maps 47 WCAG AA semantic roles, quantizes the 4px/8px grid, synthesizes certified React/TSX components in `components/ui/*.tsx`, and commits the snapshot to `.tds/vcs/`)*.
3. **Launch the Review Studio:**
   ```bash
   npx -y @trainable-ds/cli serve --port 5000
   ```
   Provide the user with `http://localhost:5000/overview.html` to visually inspect and test the extracted design system live.

---

### Protocol 3: UI Generation Using Certified Primitives
If the user tells you:
- *"Follow the design system protocol at <url>/llms.txt and adhere strictly to /DESIGN.md for all UI generation"*
- *"Use Trainable DS"*
- *"Follow the design system at this URL"*
- *"Generate a screen/component matching our design system"*

Execute the following workflow:
1. **Initialize Workspace (if not already configured):**
   ```bash
   npx -y @trainable-ds/cli init --auto
   ```
   *This automatically generates `DESIGN.md`, `.cursor/rules/design-system.mdc`, `.cursor/mcp.json`, and injects `CLAUDE.md`.*
2. **Retrieve Context & Active Contracts:**
   - Read local [`DESIGN.md`](/DESIGN.md) or fetch [`/api/v1/context`](/api/v1/context).
   - Review certified components from [`/components.json`](/components.json) or MCP tool `list_components`.
3. **Generate UI Using Strictly Certified Primitives:**
   - **Zero Raw Values:** Never use `#hex`, `rgb(...)`, or arbitrary sizing (`p-[13px]`). Always use semantic Tailwind classes (`bg-surface-container-low`, `text-on-surface`, `bg-primary`, `text-on-primary`).
   - **8dp Spatial Quantum Grid:** All padding, margins, and gaps must be multiples of 4px/8px (`p-2`, `p-4`, `p-6`, `gap-4`).
   - **$\ge 48\times 48\text{px}$ Touch Targets:** Every button, chip, tab, and input must satisfy `min-h-[48px] min-w-[48px]` or `h-12`.
   - **Bi-Directional RTL Properties:** Use logical properties (`ps-*`, `pe-*`, `ms-*`, `me-*`) instead of physical (`pl`, `pr`, `ml`, `mr`).
   - **Sentence Case:** All button text, headings, and labels must use sentence case (`Save changes`, not `Save Changes`).
   - **Surface Containment Over Outlines & Shadows:** Never add arbitrary `1px` borders, outlines, or drop-shadows to cards, panels, or content surfaces. Modern flat container architectures establish visual hierarchy strictly through tonal surface contrast (`surface-container-lowest` through `highest`).
   - **Subpixel Text Rendering Contract:** Do NOT apply `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;` across stylesheets. Disabling subpixel rendering strips 100–150 weight units from typography on macOS/WebKit. Always default to `-webkit-font-smoothing: auto;`.
   - **Interactive Pseudo-State Fidelity:** Never guess or hallucinate hover/active styles (e.g. turning text link-blue or adding random underlines). Adhere strictly to the state contracts in `components.json` (e.g. navigation tabs shift color and weight without underlines; editorial headlines underline without changing font color; buttons use state-layer overlays).
   - **Asset Vector Sanctity:** Brand marks, logos, and emblems must ALWAYS be rendered using authentic vector SVGs from `icons.json` or inline SVGs. NEVER approximate brand logos using styled HTML text spans.
   - **Strict Command & Sketch Fidelity (Zero Feature Hallucination):** Strictly adhere to what the user explicitly requested or drew in a sketch, wireframe, or prompt. NEVER invent, assume, or inject unrequested features, action buttons, widgets, or toggles (e.g. heating, flash & horn, walk to car, tire pressure) to fill out a screen.
   - **Intentional Whitespace & Placeholder Mandate:** If an area is marked as whitespace (e.g. *"Whitespace (for now)"*) or left unoccupied in a sketch, DO NOT invent features to occupy that space. The agent MUST either:
     1. Proactively ask the user if they wish to add specific features in that area, OR
     2. Render an explicit, styled placeholder container (e.g. dashed outline with clear text `"Whitespace (intentionally left empty per user sketch)"`) that preserves the intended layout and clarifies the space was intentionally left blank.
4. **Closed-Loop Audit & Auto-Repair:**
   - In CLI:
     ```bash
     npx -y @trainable-ds/cli evaluate <filepath> --strict
     ```
   - Over HTTP:
     ```bash
     curl -s -X POST /api/v1/evaluate -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"code":"<candidate TSX>"}'
     ```
   - Over MCP:
     Call tool `validate_code_snippet({ code: "..." })`.
   - If score < 100 or violations are returned, fix all flagged lines and re-evaluate until certified compliant.

## 2. Direct Machine-Readable Endpoints
- **Agent Guide (this file):** [`/llms.txt`](/llms.txt)
- **Comprehensive Prompt Bundle:** [`/llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt)
- **Root DESIGN.md Facade:** [`/DESIGN.md`](/DESIGN.md)
- **W3C DTCG 3-Tier Tokens JSON:** [`/tokens.json`](/tokens.json)
- **6-Family Component Catalog JSON:** [`/components.json`](/components.json)
- **Harvested Origin Fonts JSON:** [`/fonts.json`](/fonts.json)
- **Harvested Vector Icons JSON:** [`/icons.json`](/icons.json)
- **Interactive Human Reviewer Portal:** [`/overview.html`](/overview.html)
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP) Discovery:** [`/.well-known/mcp.json`](/.well-known/mcp.json)
- **Headless Evaluation API:** `POST /api/v1/evaluate`
- **Compact Context API:** `GET /api/v1/context`
- **Remote MCP SSE Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/mcp/sse` & `POST /api/v1/mcp/message`

---

## 3. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools
If connected over MCP, the following tools are available:
- `harvest_design_system_site({ url: string, pages?: string[], max_loops?: number, threshold?: number })`: Full site discovery, font/icon harvesting, alignment loops, and overview generation.
- `discover_subpages({ url: string, max_pages?: number })`: Discovers subpages via sitemap and navigation links, categorized by UX archetype.
- `align_design_system_with_source({ source_url: string, template_path?: string, max_loops?: number, threshold?: number })`: Runs visual alignment loops against a specific page.
- `get_design_tokens({ category?: "color" | "typography" | "spacing" | "elevation" | "shape" | "motion" | "all", tier?: "ref" | "sys" | "comp" | "all" })`
- `list_components({ family?: "actions" | "communication" | "containment" | "navigation" | "selection" | "text-inputs" | "all" })`
- `get_component_schema({ component_name: string })`
- `get_component_code({ component_name: string, dir?: string })`: Fetches executable TSX prototype component code and review status JIT.
- `validate_code_snippet({ code: string, filename?: string, strict?: boolean })`
- `suggest_remediation({ component_type: string, intent?: string })`
- `get_design_guidelines()`

CLI equivalent: `npx @trainable-ds/cli doc <Component>`
